scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-blender-worker.mjs && node scripts/copy-test-fixtures.mjs && node scripts/runtime-build-manifest.mjs --write

scripts.plugin:test: find plugin/src -name '*.luau' -print0 | xargs -0 luau-compile --only-parse && node scripts/check-plugin-ui.mjs && lune run plugin/test/verify-hardening.luau
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run plugin:build
